formulas.pooled: y ~ log_use (least squares, no random effects)
formulas.scene: y ~ log_use + (1 + log_use | level) + (1 + log_use | level:scene)
formulas.route_int: y ~ log_use + (1 + log_use | level) + (1 + log_use | level:scene) + (1 | level:scene:route)
formulas.route: y ~ log_use + (1 + log_use | level) + (1 + log_use | level:scene) + (1 + log_use | level:scene:route)
